result.title: Robust Pixel-wise Digital Image Correlation under Large Motions and Illumination Variations via a Global-to-Local Hybrid Neural Field
result.summary: Digital image correlation (DIC) is a widely used non-contact technique for full-field displacement measurement. Data-driven deep-learning DIC offers rapid inference but may generalize poorly to unseen speckle patterns, deformation modes, noise levels, and illumination conditions. Classical optimization-based DIC and recent image-constrained neural formulations avoid labeled displacement data, yet their convergence and accuracy remain vulnerable to initialization, large rigid-body motion, fine non-uniform deformation, and gray-value disturbances. This paper presents a global-to-local hybrid neural DIC framework for robust pixelwise measurement. Stage 1 estimates a dominant in-plane rigid transformation through coarse rotation search, phase correlation, and masked refinement, providing a reliable initialization under large translation and rotation. Stage 2 represents the residual displacement with a hybrid Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) and multilayer perceptron (MLP), and optimizes it using a valid-overlap, illumination-robust structural loss. The local gray-value model explicitly accommodates multiplicative and additive intensity changes. Simulated and real experiments demonstrate accurate and stable displacement recovery under noise, non-uniform deformation, large rotation, illumination variation, and degraded imaging conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出全局到局部的混合神经数字图像相关（DIC）框架：第一阶段用粗旋转搜索、相位相关和掩码细化估计主导刚体变换以提供可靠初始化，第二阶段用 KAN 与 MLP 混合表示残差位移，并以有效重叠、抗光照的结构损失优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显式粗初始化＋神经场残差细化」的分阶段状态估计与显式建模乘性/加性灰度扰动的做法，可能为 LVR 中粗到细的 latent 状态更新与视觉证据筛选提供借鉴，实际可迁移性仍需核查。
